name: CI-Investigation
details:
Systematic investigation of CI/local ESLint divergence.

**Mystery**: Local lint passes (0 errors), CI lint fails.
**Goal**: Identify root cause and determine fix strategy.

**Approach**: Empirical investigation through logs, versions, and reproduction attempts.

tasks.name: CI Logs
tasks.details:
Check actual CI failure output to see:
- Which ESLint rules are failing
- Which files/lines are flagged
- Exact error messages

sub_tasks.name: Get PR checks
sub_tasks.details: Use gh CLI to get PR #2 check status and logs

sub_tasks.name: Analyze errors
sub_tasks.details: Parse the actual ESLint errors from CI output

tasks.name: Version Audit
tasks.details:
Compare versions between local and CI:
- Node version
- npm version
- ESLint version
- TypeScript version
- All eslint plugins

sub_tasks.name: Check local versions
sub_tasks.details: Get actual installed versions (node, npm, eslint, typescript)

sub_tasks.name: Check CI config
sub_tasks.details: Review .github/workflows to see what versions CI uses

tasks.name: Reproduce CI Environment
tasks.details:
Try to reproduce the CI failure locally by matching CI environment:
- Test with Node 18.x, 20.x, 22.x
- Use CI's exact npm/eslint versions
- See if any version causes local failure

sub_tasks.name: Test Node 18.x
sub_tasks.details: Switch to Node 18 and run lint

sub_tasks.name: Test Node 20.x
sub_tasks.details: Switch to Node 20 and run lint

sub_tasks.name: Test Node 22.x
sub_tasks.details: Switch to Node 22 and run lint
